svg.title: DIA-203 · A stone in the stream
svg.desc: Three tall frames side by side show one stretch of a river, drawn only in long flowing current lines that swell and thin, in the manner of a woodblock print. In the first frame a rust stone has just been dropped in: it breaks the surface, spray standing up round it and broken rings widening on the water. In the second the stone lies on the bed, the current lines part round it, close up behind it, and two small eddies curl in its wake. The third frame, a little way downstream, holds no stone, and its current lines are the very same lines as the undisturbed water of the first frame.
svg.text: PART II · CONSTANTS, BUFFERS, AND INFRASTRUCTURE
a filter, a rate limit, a threshold, a usage cap
DIA-203 · A system absorbs a parameter change and carries on.
